_doc: The trick director (src/client/director.ts): slow motion and cinematic cameras at the big moments, in play, the instant
replay (X), the results replay, the share clip (V) and ./skate clip. The sim never changes: slow motion only runs fewer
of its 120 Hz ticks per real second (the frame loop's time scale), and every number here is sim time unless it says real.
slowmo: speed (the time scale held), easeIn and easeOut (sim seconds into and out of it), hold (real seconds held at speed,
centred on the air's peak), pitch (the effects' playback rate at full slow motion) and lowpass (their cutoff then, Hz);
music and voices are untouched. levels: Settings > Camera > Slow motion, Big moments or Every trick: air (a flip or grab
in an air of at least minAir seconds, its peak minHeight metres over the ground below), bigAir (the slow orbit instead of
the swing), grind (a grind that will last minSeconds at minSpeed, from the rail left and the speed on it), gap (a gap of
at least minPoints), special (a special trick), cooldown (sim seconds after a moment before the next). noSlowmo: games
(session game) where time matters against someone: no slow motion and no trick cameras (also with two players).
shots: spring (rad/s, the critically damped swing into a shot, and slower back to the chase camera), hold (sim seconds a shot
stays after its slow motion ends); swing (a flip or grab, a special: deg round from behind toward the open side, dist,
height over the skater, look height, fov), orbit (a big air: the swing's start, turning turn degrees over the moment),
push (a grind: from ahead along the rail, from metres in to to metres over seconds, side metres off the rail); track (a grind down
a line steeper than minDeg, a handrail or a hubba: beside it on the approach side, dist metres out, back metres behind, the look lead
metres ahead; from ahead and below, the push filmed up the stairs and the grind read as going up, a playtest report of 2026-11-16).
Settings > Camera > Trick cameras off, or Reduce motion on: the chase camera stays.
talk: the conversation camera while a line shows (any setting): from the skater's side of the pair, angle degrees off the line to the speaker
(three-quarter), dist metres plus spread x their distance back from the pair's middle, height metres up, aimed look metres up (low, so both stand clear
of the lower third where the line is), fov; eased in and out by a critically damped spring (spring rad/s, about half a second).
